_comment: Grade 7 Science diagrams, one per item of the figure list (53 of 60; 1.2, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.2, 4.4, 4.5 have no image yet). Titles were cropped off the original screenshots so they do not give answers away; letters A, B, C... were added to blank answer boxes. Entries with a 'note' need a quick check.
